items.author: Adam Aaronson
items.body_excerpt:
Nick Nurse says Dominick Barlow was “a part of the practice,” which was more of a walkthrough and not very intense given tomorrow’s early start.

Is he on the verge of returning?

“Yeah, he’s progressing.”

Says Barlow may play a lot of five when returning given current roster.

items.author: Derek Bodner
items.body_excerpt:
Nick Nurse says that Dominick Barlow  "still has a little bit of time to wait", but that they're pretty positive that his back is getting better. 

He estimates another 10-12 days before Barlow is cleared to get back on the court.

items.title: Nick Nurse with an update on Dominick Barlow’s back injury:
items.author: Chris Hine
items.body_excerpt:
Nick Nurse with an update on Dominick Barlow’s back injury: 

“He’s still got a little bit time to wait but they’re pretty positive about it getting better. I think it’ll be another 10-12 days” before clearing him to get on the court.
